root_cause: Known GitHub delivery workflows, .github scripts and material-writeback control-plane code were still classified through broad shared/website path rules. A CI-only change therefore activated backend, portal, website and automation and launched browser assurance despite having no public website artifact.
prevention: Assign known delivery-control-plane files to backend or automation before shared-path expansion, treat .github/scripts as automation, and mark the same non-runtime files as website non-artifacts. Unknown paths remain fail-closed.

evidence.observed: PR #3980 classified only workflows/scripts/tests/docs but still produced requires_preview=true and launched website/browser.
